transactions.description: All current-version transactions in the published ledger. One row per transaction_id; integer USD cents. Never add unlike accounting bases.

columns.name: transaction_id
columns.description: ORESTAR current transaction identifier, stored as text. Primary key.

columns.name: original_id
columns.description: ORESTAR original-version identifier. Not a second transaction to count. Null means not supplied.

columns.name: transaction_date
columns.description: Reported transaction date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD; not the download date.

columns.name: filed_date
columns.description: Current version filing date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD; may differ from original disclosure date.

columns.name: status
columns.description: Reported current-version status, such as Original or Amended.

columns.name: committee_id
columns.description: ORESTAR filing committee identifier, stored as text.

columns.name: committee_name
columns.description: Reported filing committee name. Not a verified candidate/race link.

columns.name: entity_id
columns.description: Conservative reported counterparty group. committee: is authoritative; record: is a fingerprint; disclosure: and unknown: are not donors.

columns.name: entity_name
columns.description: Reported counterparty name, not an independently verified identity.

columns.name: identity_status
columns.description: authoritative_committee_id, provisional_record_group, disclosure_category or unknown.

columns.name: subtype
columns.description: Original ORESTAR accounting subtype.

columns.name: basis
columns.description: Normalized accounting basis; use cash_contribution for gross cash raised and cash_payment for gross cash paid out.

columns.name: direction
columns.description: in, out or adjustment relative to the filing committee. Not sufficient to calculate cash effect without subtype semantics.

columns.name: amount_cents
columns.description: Signed integer USD cents, exact; divide by 100 for dollars. Do not sum unrelated bases.

columns.name: city
columns.description: Normalized reported counterparty city; may be blank.

columns.name: state
columns.description: Normalized reported counterparty state; may be blank.

columns.name: purpose_codes
columns.description: Reported purpose categories, not unrestricted free-text descriptions.

columns.name: source_dataset
columns.description: Public acquisition batch label; not a download path.

columns.name: source_row
columns.description: Row locator within the private source batch, not an additional ID.

columns.name: retrieved_at
columns.description: Source acquisition/file timestamp retained for provenance; not proof of source completeness.

columns.name: family
columns.description: Acquisition family. For accounting, filter basis rather than family.

columns.name: book_type
columns.description: Reported contributor/payee type. Business size, ownership and political affiliation are not inferred.

columns.name: is_disclosure_category
columns.description: True for combined or generic disclosure rows; do not count as an identified donor.

entities.description: Conservative counterparty record groups. Only committee: IDs identify an authoritative committee; other groups are not verified people or legal entities.

columns.name: entity_id
columns.description: Conservative reported counterparty group. committee: is authoritative; record: is a fingerprint; disclosure: and unknown: are not donors.

columns.name: name
columns.description: Reported name associated with this ID.

columns.name: identity_status
columns.description: authoritative_committee_id, provisional_record_group, disclosure_category or unknown.

columns.name: first_observed
columns.description: Earliest transaction date observed in this snapshot.

columns.name: last_observed
columns.description: Latest transaction date observed in this snapshot.

columns.name: records
columns.description: Number of transaction records, not a count of unique people.

aliases.description: Reported names for each conservative entity group.

candidate_finance_facts.description: Derived JSON facts for 18 reviewed council/auditor committees. Governor records are in transactions; governor interpretations are in evidence/governor/data.json.

columns.name: committee_id
columns.description: ORESTAR filing committee identifier, stored as text.

columns.name: facts_json
columns.description: JSON-encoded candidate facts; cash amounts are cents. Separately dated official balances are not refreshed by these facts.

nulls: Parquet preserves nulls. CSV uses empty fields for null/blank values; IDs should be read as strings.
